sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: Universal life separates the insurance cost from the savings element, letting policyholders adjust payments within limits. Interest credited to the cash value varies with market rates, so performance — and the risk of lapse — depends on funding discipline. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.

Key points.
Universal life insurance. Flexible permanent insurance: adjustable premiums and death benefit around a cash-value account.

In depth.
Universal life separates the insurance cost from the savings element, letting policyholders adjust payments within limits. Interest credited to the cash value varies with market rates, so performance — and the risk of lapse — depends on funding discipline. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.
